stem: Why did the U.S. government adopt a policy of containment?

options.label: A
options.text: To prevent the Soviet Union from developing nuclear weapons

options.label: B
options.text: To forcibly reduce Soviet influence within Eastern Europe

options.label: C
options.text: To prevent the Soviet Union from spreading communism

options.label: D
options.text: To forcibly remove Soviet spies from Western Europe

visual_elements: four answer choices labeled A, B, C, D
